title: The Spiritual Espousals
author: John of Ruysbroeck
description: John of Ruysbroeck describes the stages of Christian spiritual life through the image of union with the divine. The work moves from active conduct towards inward contemplation and the love that gives both their meaning.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/thespiritualespo00ruysuoft).
